description:
As a borrower I want to enter loan details and see my EMI, a chart of where the money goes,
  and a payment schedule I can filter.

elements.name: Dashboard loads with default loan and summary figures

the page title contains "EMI Calculator"
the heading reads "Loan EMI dashboard"
the dashboard shows the monthly EMI, total interest, total payment and interest share
the form is pre-filled with amount "25,00,000", rate "10" and tenure "10" "Years"

name: EMI calculator web app (Section A)

description:
Loan-type tabs, EMI at start/end of month, calendar vs financial year, expandable yearly rows,
  a balance line on the bar chart and results that update as you type or drag.

elements.name: Choosing the Home loan loan type loads its own starting values and slider range

steps.name: I open the EMI app
I choose the "Home loan" loan type
the "Home loan" loan type is selected
the form is pre-filled with amount "25,00,000", rate "10" and tenure "10" "Years"
the amount slider maximum is 10000000
the dashboard figures match my own calculation

elements.name: Choosing the Personal loan loan type loads its own starting values and slider range

steps.name: I open the EMI app
I choose the "Personal loan" loan type
the "Personal loan" loan type is selected
the form is pre-filled with amount "5,00,000", rate "12" and tenure "3" "Years"
the amount slider maximum is 3000000
the dashboard figures match my own calculation

elements.name: Choosing the Car loan loan type loads its own starting values and slider range

steps.name: I open the EMI app
I choose the "Car loan" loan type
the "Car loan" loan type is selected
the form is pre-filled with amount "8,00,000", rate "9" and tenure "5" "Years"
the amount slider maximum is 4000000
the dashboard figures match my own calculation

elements.name: Paying the EMI at the start of the month lowers the EMI and the total interest

steps.name: I open the EMI app
I enter loan amount "25,00,000", rate "10", tenure "10" "Years" and calculate
I choose to pay the EMI at the start of the month
the dashboard figures match my own calculation
the EMI equals the end-of-month EMI divided by one plus the monthly rate
the bars add up to the loan amount and the total interest

elements.name: Start-of-month timing also holds for a prepaid loan

steps.name: I open the EMI app
I enter loan amount "25,00,000", rate "10", tenure "10" "Years" and calculate
I choose to pay the EMI at the start of the month
I enter loan amount "25,00,000", rate "10", tenure "10" "Years" with an extra monthly payment of "10000" and calculate
the EMI equals the end-of-month EMI divided by one plus the monthly rate
the prepayment impact is shown

elements.name: Financial-year view groups April to March

steps.name: I open the EMI app
I enter loan amount "25,00,000", rate "10", tenure "10" "Years" and calculate
I open the "Report" page of the app
I switch the year format to "Financial year (Apr-Mar)"
the schedule rows are labelled as financial years starting "FY 2026-27"
the financial-year rows match my own calculation
I open the "Dashboard" page of the app
the bar chart has one stacked bar per financial year

elements.name: The year filter follows the chosen year format

steps.name: I open the EMI app
I enter loan amount "25,00,000", rate "10", tenure "10" "Years" and calculate

elements.name: A yearly row expands into its months and collapses again

steps.name: I open the EMI app
I enter loan amount "25,00,000", rate "10", tenure "10" "Years" and calculate
I open the "Report" page of the app
I expand the year "2030"
the schedule shows 12 month rows under that year
the month rows add up to that year's yearly row
the yearly row count is still 10
I collapse the year "2030"
no month rows are shown

elements.name: The bar chart draws the outstanding balance as a line

steps.name: I open the EMI app
I enter loan amount "25,00,000", rate "10", tenure "10" "Years" and calculate
the balance line is drawn with one point per year
the balance falls every year and ends at zero
the year-end balances match my own calculation

elements.name: Results update as you type, without pressing Calculate

steps.name: I open the EMI app
I type "40,00,000" in the loan amount field
the EMI updates by itself to match my own calculation

elements.name: Dragging the amount slider updates the EMI live

steps.name: I open the EMI app
I press ArrowRight 10 times on the loan amount slider

elements.name: An invalid value while typing does not wipe the last good result
